interpretation.axis_pattern: Fixed-state velocity change is often X-dominant, while endpoint paired-slot displacements are distributed over X/Y/Z; no automatic claim of correct height response.
excluded_in_this_panel: The .95/1.05 C perturbation is completely swallowed before the first backbone block: all64 actual embedding pairs differ.
Free predictions completely ignore this width change: all64 fixed-state velocity pairs and all16 terminal RAW free pairs differ.
The generator shows no sign-consistent endpoint width dependence: all16 RAW and all16 POST robust-width endpoint deltas are positive.
POST alone causes all observed adoption failures: the same clear failures already appear in frozen RAW visual observations.
interpretation.main: EXP67 responds to these C width changes numerically and in aggregate free X width, while semantic adoption and exact interfaces remain unresolved/poor on this panel.
not_excluded_or_not_proven: Nonzero response, positive width dependence, or a large paired-slot displacement does not prove appropriate C adoption, nearby interface layout, or attachment.
RAW/POST all96 valid CF edge counts are zero; this diagnoses absent exact legal shared edges, not whether every open boundary was required to attach.
Height/control of other attributes is untested; no statement about arbitrary C or all chairs follows from width-only8parent2noise evidence.
Smaller SEAT_HALF width slopes than OTHER are descriptive; parent identities/K/region distributions differ, so this is not an isolated causal half/full comparison.
Multiaxis endpoint movement can include trajectory sensitivity and reorganization; same-slot correspondence is not semantic surface correspondence.
No evidence selects a new loss/module/gain, establishes a threshold for weak response, or requires width slope=1.
High UNCERTAIN visual counts limit semantic conclusions; they must not be recoded as success or failure.
interpretation.timing_pattern: Mean fixed-state relative response declines from t=.1 to .6 and rises at .9. Independent-rollout displacement accumulates; probe response and trajectory divergence measure different objects.

method: Pure CPU aggregation of existing saved tables/metadata; no geometry/model rescoring

timer_scope.D0_phase: Starts before first per-output loop; includes D0 load, CPU GEO/export, validation and IO.
timer_scope.D0_proposal_seconds: Includes one prediction plus saved proposal serialization before receipt timestamp; not GPU-kernel-only time.
timer_scope.generator_loop: Starts after generator load/resource snapshot; includes sampling/probes, CPU snapshots, validation and artifact IO; excludes model load.
timer_scope.no_double_count: Per-operation sums are nested inside their phase walls and must not be added to them. Torch peaks include resident model; physical process peak remains NA.
timer_scope.probe_seconds: Includes observation, CPU copies, NPZ serialization/hash; not GPU-kernel-only time.
timer_scope.rollout_seconds: Public sampling timer includes CPU trajectory and passive velocity copies; excludes final raw export. Not GPU-kernel-only time.

review_type: Nonblind AI_PROXY visual observations; not human rating; no index-topology inference from image proximity

spatial_bin_definition.aggregation: Within each curve/bin equal-face means or RMS; mean two valid noises within parent; equal mean over valid parents.
spatial_bin_definition.delta_centroid_vx_RMS: RMS of existing face-mean delta vx, not RMS of individual corner delta vx.
spatial_bin_definition.grouping: Saved baseline free-face centroid relative to original C min/max X; no semantic part labels.
spatial_bin_definition.missing_bin: No faces -> NA and excluded with valid curve/parent counts retained.
spatial_bin_definition.outward_sign_fraction: Left: face-mean delta vx<0. Right: >0. Exact signs descriptive only; middle NA; no success cutoff.
